'''François Diederich''' (9 July 1952 – 23 September 2020)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wort.lu/de/panorama/chemiker-francois-diederich-verstorben-5f6da2d4de135b92361c4ce9|title = Chemiker François Diederich verstorben|date = 25 September 2020}}</ref> was a Luxembourgish [[chemist]] specializing in [[organic chemistry]].

==Education==
He obtained both his diploma and PhD (first synthesis of [[Kekulene]]) from the [[University of Heidelberg]] in 1977 and 1979, respectively.

==Career and research==
After [[postdoctoral]] studies with Orville L. Chapman at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] ([[UCLA]]) and habilitation at the [[Max Planck Institute for Medical Research]] in Heidelberg, he became Full Professor of Organic and Bioorganic Chemistry at [[UCLA]] in 1989. In 1992 he was appointed Professor of [[Organic Chemistry]] at [[ETH Zurich]]. He retired on 31 July 2017, and remained a research-active professor at ETH Zurich. On 16 March 2019, the [[German Chemical Society]] (Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker, GDCh) bestowed him with their highest recognition, Honorary Membership.

Diederich died on 23 September 2020 after a battle with cancer.<ref name="Professor François Diederich dies at 68 – Department of Chemistry and Applied Biosciences 2020">{{cite web | title=Professor François Diederich dies at 68 | website=Professor François Diederich dies at 68 – Department of Chemistry and Applied Biosciences | date=23 September 2020 | url=https://chab.ethz.ch/en/news-and-events/d-chab-news/2020/09/prof-francois-diederich-dies-at-68.html | access-date=14 August 2022}}</ref><ref name="Hof Hirsch pp. 11–13">{{cite journal | last1=Hof | first1=Fraser | last2=Hirsch | first2=Anna K. H. |author2-link=Anna Hirsch| title=François Diederich – In Memoriam** | journal=ChemMedChem | publisher=Wiley | volume=16 | issue=1 | date=14 December 2020 | issn=1860-7179 | doi=10.1002/cmdc.202000920 | pages=11–13| pmid=33314781 | s2cid=229172844 | doi-access=free | hdl=10033/622843 | hdl-access=free }}</ref><ref name="Förderwerk Fonds 2020">{{cite web | title=Nachruf - Prof. Dr. François Diederich | website=Förderwerk Fonds | date=29 September 2020 | url=https://www.vci.de/fonds/presse-und-infos/pressemitteilungen/nachruf.jsp | language=de | access-date=14 August 2022}}</ref>

His research interests cover a wide range of topics: 
* [[Molecular recognition]] in [[chemistry]] and [[biology]]. 
* Modern [[medicinal chemistry]]: molecular recognition studies with [[Receptor (biochemistry)|biological receptors]] and X-ray [[drug design|structure-based design]] of nonpeptidic [[enzyme inhibitor]]s. Examples of targets: [[plasmepsin]] II, IspE and IspF in the [[non-mevalonate pathway]] of [[isoprenoid]] biosynthesis ([[malaria]]); t-RNA guanine transglycosylase ([[shigellosis]]); [[trypanothione]] reductase ([[African trypanosomiasis|African sleeping sickness]]). 
* Supramolecular nanosystems and nano-patterned surfaces.
* Advanced materials based on [[Carbon|carbon-rich]] [[alkyne|acetylenic]] molecular architecture: new organic super-[[Electron acceptor|acceptors]] and their inter- and intramolecular [[charge-transfer complex]]es, [[optoelectronics|opto-electronic]] materials for molecular electronic circuitry, [[chirality|chiral]] [[macrocycle|macrocyclic]] and [[Open-chain compound|acyclic]] [[allene|alleno]]-acetylenes, amplification of [[chirality]] and its transfer from the molecular to the [[macroscopic scale]].

==Honors and awards==
Source:<ref name="Nationale Akademie der Wissenschaften Leopoldina 2021">{{cite web | title=Mitglieder | website=Nationale Akademie der Wissenschaften Leopoldina | date=25 September 2021 | url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitgliederverzeichnis/mitglieder/member/Member/show/francois-diederich/ | language=de | access-date=14 August 2022}}</ref>

* [[Otto Hahn Medal]] of the [[Max Planck Society]] (1979)
* [[The Camille and Henry Dreyfus Foundation|Dreyfus]] Teacher Scholar Award (1987)
* [[American Chemical Society|ACS]] [[Arthur C. Cope]] Scholar Award (1992)
* [[Otto Bayer Award]] (1993)
* Janssen Prize for Creativity in Organic Synthesis (2000)
* Havinga Medal (2000)
* [[Myron L. Bender]] & Muriel S. Bender Distinguished Summer Lecturer at [[Northwestern University]] (2004)
* [[Humboldt Prize]] (2005)
* [[Burckhardt Helferich]] Prize (2005)
* [[August Wilhelm von Hofmann]]-Denkmünze of the [[Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker|German Chemical Society]] (2006)
* ACS [[Ronald Breslow]] Award for Achievements in Biomimetic Chemistry (2007)
* {{ill|Adolf-von-Baeyer-Denkmünze|de}} of the [[German Chemical Society]] (2011)
* Honorary Doctoral Degree, [[Technion]], Haifa (2012)
* Ernst Hellmut Vits-Preis (2014)
* Prix Paul Metz by the Institut Grand Ducal, Luxembourg (2014)
* EFMC Nauta Award for Pharmacochemistry and for outstanding results of scientific research in the field of Medicinal Chemistry (2016)
* Honorary Membership of the German Chemical Society (Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker, GDCh) (2019)
